seoTitle: Free Fitness Consultation in Braintree | CrossFit East Coast
seoDescription: Book a free consultation at CrossFit East Coast in Braintree, MA. Talk with a coach, see if we're the right fit, and leave with a plan for your goals.
headline: Book Your *Free* Consultation
subhead: Sit down with a coach in {city}, see if we're the right fit, and leave with a plan built for your goals. Yours to keep, whether you join or not.

steps.title: We text you to schedule

steps.text: Talk through your goals, see if we're a good fit, and leave with a plan you can use either way.

finalSubtext: Find out if we're the right fit and walk away with a plan built for your goals. Claim yours now and we'll text you to set a time.
notes: Second CrossFit East Coast page: free consultation offer (Ryan: it is a fit check plus a detailed plan whether they join or not; not 1-on-1, others may be there; keep it from sounding medical; no length given). Same brand as gyms/crossfit-east-coast. form-embed.html is a COPY of the free class form (FCWeb) until a separate consult form exists, because one GHL form can only redirect to one thank-you page.

thankYou.headline: Your *Free Consultation* Is Claimed
thankYou.subhead: Keep an eye on your phone. A coach from {gym} will text you shortly to set up your consultation.

steps.title: Watch for our text
steps.text: A coach will text you to find a time that fits your schedule.

steps.title: Pick your time
steps.text: Reply with the day and time that work best. That locks in your consultation.

steps.title: Bring your goals
steps.text: Come ready to talk about where you are now and where you want to be. You'll leave with a plan either way.
